questions.question: Match Shape A (L=12 cm, W=8 cm) to its area and perimeter.
questions.solution: Area = 12 cm × 8 cm = 96 cm², Perimeter = 2 × (12 cm + 8 cm) = 40 cm

questions.question: Match Shape B (L=10 cm, W=5 cm) to its area and perimeter.
questions.solution: Area = 10 cm × 5 cm = 50 cm², Perimeter = 2 × (10 cm + 5 cm) = 30 cm

questions.question: Match Shape C (L=9 cm, W=6 cm) to its area and perimeter.
questions.solution: Area = 9 cm × 6 cm = 54 cm², Perimeter = 2 × (9 cm + 6 cm) = 30 cm

tasks.title: Enrichment Task: Relationship of area and perimeter.

questions.question: Draw a square with the same area and perimeter. Label the sides.
questions.answer: A square with side length 4 cm has both area and perimeter equal to 16.
questions.hint: Let side = s. Area = s², Perimeter = 4s. Set s² = 4s and solve for s.
questions.solution: s² = 4s → s = 4 (since s ≠ 0). So, a square with side 4 cm has area = 16 cm² and perimeter = 16 cm.
